requirements: Free Listing tier exists: standard directory listing, basic analytics, 1 team member — approval ~14 days

preparation: Tool name, URL, category, description, logo

workflow: Pick 'Free Listing' ($0/forever) for the zero-cost route and submit tool details

watchFor: Page banner: 'Tool Submission Portal Under Active Development' — the submit flow may be partially unfinished

Heavy upsell density: marketing plans $399–999/mo plus paid placements ($99–799)
Inflated marketing claims on the page (1M+/2M+ monthly visitors, 96% approval rate) — unverified self-reported stats

countsAsLive: The tool has a profile page at aicorner.net/ai-tools/<slug> and appears in its category listing
